facts.fact: The World Bank appraisal document says the project will support institutionalising and operationalising a Unified Social Registry as a common household database to select beneficiaries for safety nets and other social programmes, with the DN (national food crisis framework) as lead institution; shock-response beneficiaries are to be selected from the social registry where available.

The World Bank appraisal document says the Cellule des Filets Sociaux has a solid MIS and electronic payment modules in use, with cash-transfer payments based on a centrally managed database and delivered by payment agencies electronically, over 60,000 beneficiary households paid monthly; no date is given for the state described, so the document's published date is used.
